fieldDefinitions.originalATDPresent: Token exists in the same original file; resource definition exists at original path. This is source presence, not proof identical behavior.
fieldDefinitions.phaseAPortChanged: Current containing line/definition differs from original after stripping line-end whitespace; includes syntax/EOL-independent port changes, not an inferred motive.
fieldDefinitions.namespace: Literal resource namespace for IDs; owning assets namespace for translation keys; null for non-namespaced integration symbols.
fieldDefinitions.lineAndColumn: One-based; null column for physical resource definitions.
fieldDefinitions.classification: Primary integration sensitivity; kinds distinguish keys/definitions/symbols. Review stage denotes a handoff, not execution.
fieldDefinitions.trackerLiteralParameter: Score/statistic entries store finalValue; nearby-entity entries store radius and derive finalValue from entity set/baby separation. Detailed 86-entry map is in b2_atd_integration_map.json.
fieldDefinitions.scopeConservativeSuperset: Vanilla minecraft resource references and native ATD translation definitions are included conservatively alongside BACAP references. Counts describe occurrences, not upstream content additions or required edits.
